column1: # Perl corpus: sort. Format and regeneration: crates/builtins/src/perl/tests.rs.

column2: print join('|',sort {lc($a) cmp lc($b)} qw(Zebra apple Apricot banana)),"\n";
print join('|',sort qw(z abc Abc a aa)),"\n";
print join('|',sort {$a cmp $b} qw(z a b)),"\n";
print join('|',sort {length($a)<=>length($b) || $a cmp $b} qw(cat dog r fox a bb cc)),"\n";
package Sorter; sub cmpnum {$a<=>$b} package main; print join('|',sort Sorter::cmpnum 9,100,2),"\n";
print join('|',sort {$b cmp $a} qw(z a b)),"\n";
print join('|',reverse sort qw(a c b)),"\n";
print join('|',sort {0} qw(e a d b c)),"\n";
print join('|',sort {length($a)<=>length($b)} qw(cat dog r fox a bb cc)),"\n";
